capabilities.g1.title: On your computer
capabilities.g1.summary: Jaris does for you what you would do with the mouse and keyboard.
capabilities.g1.i1.title: Open an app

capabilities.g1.i3.title: Press a key, click

capabilities.g1.i5.title: Look at your screen
capabilities.g1.i5.description: Describes what's displayed, or answers a specific question about it.
capabilities.g1.i6.title: Do a whole task on its own
capabilities.g1.i6.description: Several actions in a row in an app or a website, in the background when the app allows it: you keep using your PC. Slower: Jaris warns you before starting.
capabilities.g1.i6.example: open YouTube and search for a guitar tutorial

capabilities.g1.i7.description: Creates the image you describe, on your PC, and shows it in the Chat. Its model installs with the others (Options → Models).

capabilities.g1.i8.title: Tell you how the machine is doing
capabilities.g1.i9.title: Shut down or restart the PC

capabilities.g2.title: Look up information
capabilities.g2.summary: For what Jaris doesn't know, or what has changed since.
capabilities.g2.i1.title: Search the web
capabilities.g2.i1.description: For recent info or info it isn't sure about. The search runs on your machine, not on a paid service.
capabilities.g2.i2.title: Read a specific page
capabilities.g2.i2.description: When a search snippet isn't enough: exact opening hours, address, price.
capabilities.g2.i2.example: read this page and summarize it
capabilities.g3.title: Remember you
capabilities.g3.summary: What you tell it once, it keeps — on your disk, never online.
capabilities.g3.i1.title: Remember something
capabilities.g3.i1.description: A habit, a preference, a fact — found again even after a restart.
capabilities.g3.i1.example: remember that I drink tea, not coffee
capabilities.g3.i2.title: Bring it back later
capabilities.g3.i2.description: It rereads what it noted as soon as you refer to it.
capabilities.g3.i2.example: what do I drink in the morning, again?
capabilities.g3.i3.title: Remind you of something at a set time
capabilities.g3.i3.description: Said out loud at the right moment, even if Jaris was restarted in the meantime.
capabilities.g3.i3.example: remind me to take out the laundry in 10 minutes
capabilities.g4.title: Create an app (Code mode)
capabilities.g4.summary: Describe what you want, Jaris writes it and shows it to you right away.
capabilities.g4.i1.title: Start from an idea
capabilities.g4.i1.description: Jaris writes the page, reviews it itself, and fixes what it finds. You can attach an image as a model.
capabilities.g4.i1.example: a kitchen timer with a big button
capabilities.g4.i2.title: Change what already exists
capabilities.g4.i2.description: Ask for a change on an open app: it's updated in place.
capabilities.g4.i2.example: make the background black and the text bigger
capabilities.g4.i3.title: Find your creations
capabilities.g4.i3.description: They all stay in the left column after a restart, and you can delete them.
capabilities.g5.title: Create images (Image)
capabilities.g5.summary: The Image button on the left: Jaris draws on your PC, without sending anything to the internet. Your images stay in the list.
capabilities.g5.i1.title: An image from a description
capabilities.g5.i1.description: Describe the subject, the style and the colors: Jaris draws it, then you can save it wherever you want.
capabilities.g5.i1.example: an astronaut cat on the Moon, watercolor style, blue tones
capabilities.g5.i2.title: Find your images
capabilities.g5.i2.description: All your images, even those requested in the Chat or by voice, are in the left column.
capabilities.g6.title: Create videos (Video)
capabilities.g6.summary: The Video button on the left: Jaris creates a short video on your PC with Wan 2.2. It's slow: several minutes per video.
capabilities.g6.i1.title: A video from a description
capabilities.g6.i1.description: Describe the scene and what moves: Jaris creates 1 to 5 seconds of video (length chosen with the clock in the input box), which you can save wherever you want.
capabilities.g6.i1.example: a ginger cat walking in the snow at sunset
capabilities.g6.i2.title: Animate an image
capabilities.g6.i2.description: Attach an image with the “+” in the input box and describe the motion: Jaris makes it move.

capabilities.g7.title: Chat in writing

capabilities.g7.i2.title: Show it an image
capabilities.g7.i2.description: Attach a photo or a screenshot: Jaris describes it, or uses it as a model in Code mode.

capabilities.g7.i3.description: What you say out loud continues the conversation open in the Chat, and vice versa.
capabilities.g7.i4.title: From your phone
capabilities.g7.i4.description: Options → Jaris anywhere: write to Jaris, talk to it (it answers out loud), create images and videos and find them again, from anywhere, encrypted, with no app to install. The phone shows whether the PC is on and can shut it down (with one minute to cancel); Jaris never types or clicks there.

picks.legend: For each role, Jaris weighs reliability against strength among the models that fit your machine. For Low, Medium, High and Code, strength comes from your duels, as on Arena: every model starts at 0 points, and 400 more points multiply strength by 10. The score is that strength multiplied by the chance of completing 5 actions in a row without error (Questions), then, for Low, Medium and High, by the share of real requests completed (Requests). Low takes the best score among the fastest, Medium the best that fits on your graphics card, High and Code the best even if it spills into RAM. Vision takes the most intelligent among those that read images (Artificial Analysis), Image the only drawing model if it fits your machine, Video the best quality your machine can run. Speed: published by Artificial Analysis, not the speed on your machine.

For each role, Jaris searches the whole list: the smartest among the fastest for Low, the smartest that fits on your card for Medium, the smartest overall for High and Code. The category only helps spot fast or powerful models. In conversation, a model that often makes up answers loses points; for Code, the Terminal-Bench 2.1 coding test is what counts.

runtime.title: Installing Jaris
runtime.intro: Jaris is downloading what it needs to run entirely on your computer: the conversation engine and speech recognition. It takes a few minutes the first time, and you have nothing to do.
unscored.working: Testing {model} — the model is still answering ({minutes} min)
unscored.allScored: All Jaris models have a score.
unscored.changed: The tests have changed: requests played end to end for conversation (is the request really done?), real screenshots for vision, and apps actually opened and clicked for code. Each model only retakes the tests it's missing. Meanwhile, Jaris keeps its current choices. A model that has never been tested is never chosen.
unscored.confirm: Each model is downloaded, tested (40 complete requests, 8 of them replayed, 17 questions on screenshots asked twice for vision, 5 apps for code), then deleted — except the ones you already had. Everything it answers is saved so it can be checked again later. The code test uses Microsoft Edge in the background, without showing anything. Large models overflow into RAM: allow several hours, and close games and heavy software during the test. A model too big for your PC is skipped.
unscored.resume: You can stop it at any time, even by closing Jaris: the next time the test runs, it resumes after the last finished model.
unscored.send: Send the benchmark-nouveaux-modeles.md file so the scores can be added to Jaris.

duel.ranking.title: Ranking from your votes
duel.ranking.empty: No votes in this category yet.

duel.preparing.hidden: The models' names stay hidden until you vote.

duel.ask.hint: Model A answers first. Model B answers once you have checked what A did.

duel.actions.title: What it asked your PC to do
duel.preview.title: Model {side}'s app

duel.vote.title: Which one answered better?
